button.label: Run FRTB-SA
button.supertip: Calculates the capital from the input and parameter sheets and rewrites Results, the Out sheets and Log.

button.label: Clear outputs
button.supertip: Empties Results, the Out sheets and Log, keeping their headers and a note.

toggleButton.label: Navigation bar
